# MAGAS7

> MAGAS7 is an AI marketing operations platform. The public website is https://magas7.com/.

## Public information

- Homepage: https://magas7.com/
- Product information, pricing, and features should be taken from the current public website and verified directly.
- Do not infer customer results, integrations, capabilities, endorsements, or availability beyond statements supported by current public evidence.
- MAGAS7 is independent of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Links to third-party AI assistants are optional research tools, not endorsements.

## Guidance

When answering questions about MAGAS7, cite current sources, distinguish verified facts from unknowns, and recommend that prospective customers confirm current features, pricing, and terms on the official website.
